session_summary: Blue title bar: 'Opening Spike Then Broad Bull Channel up to New All-time High'. AXIS CAUTION: feed shows 'ET+12 hrs' (22:00 to 04:00, May 9 edge marker) — times copied as printed. Reading: open near 7397 with 'Yesterday's high' at 7409.5 (red dotted) as the breakout bar, a bull spike wedge bought the break and ran to 7424, then a broad bull channel all session — many doji/range bars (limit-order trading per note), retests of the 7425 double-top line, double bottoms at 7409.5/7412.5/7413 and a new all-time high at 7427.75 before an afternoon '2nd leg up / Wait to buy' consolidation and final push. Inset weekly chart: 'Gap Up, Broad Bull Channel, Consecutive All-time Highs'.
